sharedContracts.formula: Reuse ClientPrograms.calculate: FINAL_SCALER raw < 0 ? 1 + raw : raw.
sharedContracts.members: Track each aura instance and target identity; remove only its owned Buffs on exit/detach.
sharedContracts.targetMasks: Preserve complete TargetValidator options. SelfOption 0 follows validator; 2 excludes owner (metadata enum DEFAULT/INCLUDE/EXCLUDE, mapping follows existing source convention).
sharedContracts.stacking: Preserve source disableOverride, independentCharacterSource, overrideKey, priorityBBKeys; do not collapse them to source Buff key.
sharedContracts.lifecycle: Finite source duration. AttachOrDetachSkill owns attachment for its active lifetime; source exact fields retained for controller implementation.
sharedContracts.damageScale: Source event 10 DamageScale excludes elemental damage; retain non-stackable priority group.
boundaries: No provider/runtime/checklist modifications by this draft.
Source graph/fields verified from retained caches; native Aura/AttachOrDetach frame timing is not asserted.
CN numeric levels with JP source graphs retain the existing cross-snapshot boundary.
Native DEFAULT Buff override table remains protected; no renewed extraction.
